show.description: Revenge of my fake bride follows Laila, a proud young woman betrayed on her wedding day and thrown out of her home. Rescued by Nakul, her fiancé’s rival with a hidden vendetta. She is drawn into a storm of love, power, and revenge. As loyalties shatter and enemies close in, will Laila remain a pawn in their game, or rise as the queen who rewrites it all? Watch now!
